name: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi
description: RA4M1 MCU + ESP32-S3 WiFi/BT combo. 48MHz, USB-C, LED matrix.
details: The Arduino UNO R4 WiFi is the most powerful UNO board yet. It combines the RA4M1 microcontroller with an ESP32-S3 co-processor for seamless Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity. Features a 12×8 LED matrix and USB-C for power and programming.

name: ESP32-S3 DevKit Pro
description: Xtensa LX7 dual-core, 240MHz, AI accelerator, BLE 5.0 + WiFi 6.
details: The ESP32-S3 DevKit Pro is the ultimate IoT development platform. Powered by the dual-core Xtensa LX7 at 240MHz with a built-in AI accelerator for on-device ML. Supports BLE 5.0 and WiFi 6 for blazing-fast wireless performance.

name: Flipper Zero
description: Multi-tool for pentesters. RF, NFC, IR, RFID, iButton, GPIO.
details: Flipper Zero is a portable multi-tool for pentesters and geeks. It can interact with digital systems and emulate RFID, NFC, Bluetooth, IR, and sub-1GHz signals. Open-source firmware, active community, and endless possibilities.

name: Raspberry Pi 5
description: BCM2712 quad-core A76 @ 2.4GHz, 8GB RAM, PCIe 2.0, USB 3.0.
details: The Raspberry Pi 5 is the most powerful SBC from the Raspberry Pi Foundation. With a custom BCM2712 processor, PCIe interface, and dual 4K output — it is a full desktop replacement in the palm of your hand.

name: IoT Mega Kit v3
description: ESP32 + 40+ sensors, OLED, relays, breadboard, full project guide.
details: Everything you need to start with IoT. Includes an ESP32 board, 40+ sensors and modules, OLED display, relay modules, breadboards, jumper wires, and a 20-project guide PDF.

name: USB Rubber Ducky v3
description: HID injection tool. DuckyScript 3.0, payload storage, programmable.
details: The USB Rubber Ducky v3 masquerades as a keyboard and executes pre-programmed keystroke payloads at superhuman speed. DuckyScript 3.0 brings conditionals, variables, and advanced logic to payload development.

name: ESP32-CAM AI Vision
description: OV2640 2MP camera, face detection, WiFi stream, microSD slot.
details: Compact AI vision module with a 2MP OV2640 camera. Supports face detection, recognition, and live MJPEG streaming over WiFi. Perfect for security cameras, wildlife monitoring, and computer vision projects.

name: CC2531 Zigbee USB Dongle
description: Zigbee sniffer & coordinator. Compatible with Zigbee2MQTT, Home Assistant.
details: Versatile Zigbee device that works as a sniffer or Zigbee coordinator. Fully compatible with Zigbee2MQTT and Home Assistant for smart home automation.
